title: Senior Embedded Systems & Mechatronics Engineer
description: Design core embedded hardware, firmware systems, mechatronics control units, and industrial IoT solutions for automotive & industrial products.
details:
### Role Overview
Seeking an experienced Embedded Systems Engineer to design microcontroller hardware, RTOS firmware, and industrial mechatronics systems.

### Key Responsibilities
- Design embedded hardware schematics, PCB layouts, and C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers (ARM, STM32).
- Implement industrial communication protocols (CAN bus, Modbus, MQTT, SPI/I2C).
- Conduct hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, thermal analysis, and EMI/EMC compliance validation.

### Requirements
- B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechatronics Engineering.
- 5+ years of experience in embedded firmware, RTOS, and mechatronic hardware design.
